jobs.title: Promoted Ads || Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE WE?
Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit  www.livenationentertainment.com .

WHO ARE YOU?
Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE JOB
The Associate Product Manager will support key Promoted Ads roadmap initiatives in the form of creating requirements, doing discovery and research, drafting briefs for design and/or engineering, testing and supporting deployments. The role will be highly collaborative with other product peers, design, engineering, program and business teammates.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
- Product Strategy : Help manage the entire product life cycle - influencing product strategy and direction; defining and prioritizing product requirements, features and functionality; contribute to product roadmaps.

- Requirements Definition : Help manage feature development and product rollout including development of specs and acceptance criteria for user stories.

- Development Oversight : Be responsible for the daily planning of software development in an agile environment, ensuring the development team consistently has a groomed backlog of priority tickets to build.

- Data-Driven Decision-Making : Utilize data and analytics to measure product performance, gather insights, and make informed decisions to optimize the product.

- Stakeholder Management : Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful execution of product initiatives.

- Testing and Quality Assurance : Define testing strategies and work with QA teams to ensure the product meets quality standards before release.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
- Interest and excitement around product development & management with some experience (internship, etc)

- Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, computer science, or related field.  MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.

- Excellent communication, time management and collaboration skills.

- Experience working in e-commerce or retail industries is a plus.

- An aptitude or interest in solving business needs and converting requirements into clear, coherent specifications using user stories, acceptance criteria, and other supporting documentation.

- Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- A deep product-focused mindset, with a desire to understand your customers and what will make their use of your output easier and more efficient.

- Curious by nature, enjoy looking into problems around your core tasks, experimenting with potential solutions.

BENEFITS & PERKS
Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

HEALTH : Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
YOURSELF : Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
WEALTH : 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
FAMILY : New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
CAREER : Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
OTHERS : Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

jobs.title: LN Media & Sponsorship || Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
WHO ARE WE?
Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit www.livenationentertainment.com .

WHO ARE YOU?
Passionate and driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward-thinking, and collaborative. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you, please read on!

THE JOB
Live Nation’s Media & Sponsorship division is seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive the day-to-day execution and coordination of technical initiatives supporting the continued growth of the Setlist.fm platform. This role serves as the operational bridge between product leadership and external development partners, ensuring that roadmap priorities are translated into structured delivery plans and that multiple technical workstreams stay aligned and on track.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and effective at communicating across technical and non-technical audiences. This role partners closely with the Product Owner, Project Manager, and external engineering vendors in a small, fast-moving team environment where flexibility and self-direction are essential.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO
- Drive day-to-day technical execution and delivery coordination for the Setlist.fm platform, including feature development, site improvements, and bug resolution across external vendor teams.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for the external development team, managing priorities, clarifying technical requirements, and ensuring consistent delivery against roadmap goals.

- Translate product and business requirements into well-scoped technical tasks, milestones, statements of work, and delivery plans in close partnership with product leadership.

- Coordinate and manage additional technical vendors and contractors across related initiatives such as data infrastructure, reporting dashboards, and web development projects.

- Maintain visibility into timelines, risks, dependencies, and quality standards across all technical workstreams, proactively flagging issues and keeping stakeholders informed.

- Identify and implement process improvements to increase efficiency, reduce friction between teams, and strengthen delivery practices across the program.

- Support platform stability and performance by surfacing technical gaps, tracking resolution of bugs and maintenance items, and ensuring quality standards are met prior to release.

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING
- 6+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, or a similar delivery-focused role supporting digital product and engineering initiatives for consumer-facing web platforms.

- Strong working knowledge of modern web technologies, development workflows, and software delivery lifecycles — enough to engage credibly with engineering teams without necessarily writing code day-to-day.

- Proven experience managing execution through external engineering teams, agencies, vendors, or technical contractors, including experience developing statements of work and vendor deliverables.

- Demonstrated ability to translate product requirements into structured execution plans and manage multiple parallel workstreams across distributed teams.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to bridge product, business, and technical audiences — translating complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities and a degree of ambiguity.

- Self-starter who thrives with limited direction and can proactively identify what needs to happen next without waiting to be told.

- Familiarity with web-focused technologies (Python, JavaScript/front-end frameworks) is a plus but not required.

- Passion for live music and familiarity with the concert experience is a meaningful plus — understanding what a setlist is and why fans care about it goes a long way on this team.

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa.

BENEFITS & PERKS
Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:
HEALTH: Medical, Vision and Dental benefits for you and your family, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSAs)
YOURSELF: Gene rous paid time off policy including paid holidays, sick time and paid days off for your birthday, Free concert tickets
WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, Stock Program
FAMILY: New parent programs & support including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, infertility support

jobs.title: Head of Digital Product (Marketing)
jobs.description:
Job Summary:
Company: Live Nation
Department: Marketing
Location: Farringdon, London
Reports to: VP, Digital
Working Hours: Full time including evenings and weekends as required
Job Type: Permanent

Role Description

The Head of Digital Products works alongside the VP, Digital to deliver industry leading platforms including websites and mobile apps for our festivals and concerts that drive engagement, first party data and ultimately, ticket sales.

You’ll lead on the project management, delivery and maintenance of a portfolio of digital platforms, driving innovation and continual optimisation, supported by a talented team.

You’ll be an experienced data specialist, analysing results to optimise user experience and ticket sales. You’ll also work to overhaul reporting dashboards and ensure that data tech is continually reviewed and optimised.

You’ll review processes and tools used across the team to drive efficiency and AI integration, in collaboration with the Head of Ops.

You’ll be a confident project manager, launching websites and apps from scratch and will have a grounding in coding. Projects will be a mix of external and internal builds.

You’ll be a digital tech leader, working with multiple stakeholders across events to recommend solutions that deliver business outcomes.

What it’s like to work in the Team

As the global leaders in live entertainment, our job is to bring fans and artists together, where audiences create magical memories through live shows.

Our team is made up of a diverse group of individuals who all share the same passion for music and entertainment. This is a fast paced but supportive environment - we are committed to working as a team to deliver results.

What we can offer you

Live Nation offers impressive employee benefits including tickets to shows and festivals and unlimited annual leave. The Farmiloe Building in Farringdon, London is a beautiful office to work in. Staff can enjoy use of arcade games in the basement games room, onsite gym equipment plus fitness and meditation classes. In addition to this, the office has a fully stocked complimentary coffee bar with barista to serve you your favourite coffee as you walk into the office and offers heavily subsidised lunch options. We hold regular staff events in our atrium stage space including hosting speakers and open mic nights to showcase Live Nation employee talent.

Who you are

Competencies / Skills / Knowledge / Experience

- Experienced digital product manager with track record in managing and delivering projects from scratch
- Demonstrable experience in implementing / auditing data tools; coding / data engineering; leading teams
- Manage multiple projects to completion under in a fast-paced dynamic environment
- Confident data analyst
- Exceptional communication skills (both written and verbal)
- Ability to work in collaboration with various stakeholders

Behaviours

The following attributes determine how the role will be carried out and are required to be a success

- Proactive, self-starter and a team player

- Able to work evenings and weekends when necessary

- Flexibility to accommodate change

- Demonstrate passion for the customer and what makes them click

- Immaculate attention to detail

- Curious

- Solutions-focused

What the role includes

- Working with VP, Digital Marketing to create Digital Product roadmap
- Leading relationships with digital agencies – internal and external to drive innovation
- Being the in-house digital product lead: working with our app partners to deliver best in class products; communicating with internal stakeholders on cross team / global products; identify and audit external tools that would support existing products; AI innovation roadmap; project lead on new large scale digital products
- Ongoing project management of – with Digital Marketing Manager: build of websites managed in-house; all festival apps
- Oversee all data tech implementation: rebuild reporting dashboards alongside internal; ongoing audit of data tech stack
- Analysis / continued improvements to platforms based on insights
- Line management of Digital Product team

Equal Opportunities

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion.  You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work.  We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife.  As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.  It’s talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender identity, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

The Company

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 500 million tickets sold annually and more than 12,000 clients worldwide.  Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 40,000 shows and 100+ festivals annually for nearly 4,000 artists in over 40 countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect over 1,000 brands with the 98 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit  www.livenationentertainment.com

APPLICATION DEADLINE: Sunday 11th October 2026. We reserve the right to close applications at any time so encourage early application where possible.
